# Setup

```{r setup-data}
source("Functions/init.R")
source_functions()
source("Functions/models/cover_specs.R")
library(patchwork)
theme_set(theme_custom1())

vmc <- if (is.null(params$vmc)) opt$vmc else params$vmc

scenarios <- c("current", "BNU-ESM", "IPSL-CM5A-MR")
future <- setdiff(scenarios, "current")

# all final layers (% cover, or % of the total for shares), per scenario
pred <- map(scenarios, \(s) read_combined_all(vmc, s)) |>
  set_names(scenarios)

# what to map, in order; `group` is the tab. Shares come before covers
vars <- tribble(
  ~layer,             ~group,        ~label,
  "cover_tree",       "Tree",        "Tree cover",
  "share_needle",     "Needleleaf",  "Needleleaf share of tree cover",
  "cover_needle",     "Needleleaf",  "Needleleaf tree cover",
  "share_broad",      "Broadleaf",   "Broadleaf share of tree cover",
  "cover_broad",      "Broadleaf",   "Broadleaf tree cover",
  "cover_shrub",      "Shrub",       "Shrub cover",
  "cover_herbaceous", "Herbaceous",  "Herbaceous cover",
  "share_c3",         "C3 grass",    "C3 grass share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_c3",         "C3 grass",    "C3 grass cover",
  "share_c4",         "C4 grass",    "C4 grass share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_c4",         "C4 grass",    "C4 grass cover",
  "share_forb",       "Forb",        "Forb share of herbaceous cover",
  "cover_forb",       "Forb",        "Forb cover"
) |>
  mutate(is_share = str_detect(layer, "^share_"))
stopifnot(all(vars$layer %in% names(pred$current)))

# legends underneath each map (overview)
legend_bottom <- theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                       legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
                       legend.title.position = "top")

#' Colour scale for a cover or share layer
#'
#' Shares: 0-100%. Cover: 0 to the largest 99th percentile among `rasts`, so
#' the scenarios share one scale.
#'
#' @param rasts List of single-layer SpatRasters (e.g. one per scenario).
#' @param is_share Logical; a share (% of the total) rather than cover.
#' @return A ggplot2 fill scale.
value_scale <- function(rasts, is_share) {
  upper <- if (is_share) {
    100
  } else {
    max(map_dbl(rasts, \(r) raster_quantile(r, 0.99)))
  }
  colorscale_cover(name = if (is_share) "Share (%)" else "Cover (%)",
                   limits = c(0, upper))
}

#' Current and future maps of one layer, and the change from current
#'
#' Left column: current, then each future scenario (one colour scale).
#' Right column: future - current (one diverging scale, symmetric, set by the
#' largest 1st / 99th percentile of change); the legends sit beside current.
#' Inset histograms of all cells.
#'
#' @param layer Layer name in `pred`.
#' @param label Title.
#' @param is_share Logical; a share rather than cover.
#' @return A patchwork object.
plot_scenarios <- function(layer, label, is_share) {
  r <- map(pred, \(p) p[[layer]])
  change <- map(future, \(s) r[[s]] - r$current) |>
    set_names(future)
  change_lim <- map_dbl(change, \(d) {
    max(abs(c(raster_quantile(d, 0.01), raster_quantile(d, 0.99))))
  }) |>
    max()

  v_scale <- value_scale(r, is_share)
  c_scale <- colorscale_diverging(name = "Change (% points)",
                                  limits = c(-change_lim, change_lim))

  g_value <- imap(r, \(x, s) {
    plot_map_conus(x, colorscale = v_scale, title = s, inset_hist = TRUE)
  })
  g_change <- imap(change, \(x, s) {
    plot_map_conus(x, colorscale = c_scale, title = paste(s, "- current"),
                   inset_hist = TRUE)
  })

  # rows: current, then each future scenario; the legends go in the empty
  # cell beside current
  plots <- c(list(g_value$current, guide_area()),
             map(future, \(s) list(g_value[[s]], g_change[[s]])) |>
               list_flatten())
  wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 2) +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = label) &
    theme(legend.direction = "horizontal",
          legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "cm"),
          legend.title.position = "top")
}
```

# Components

Version `r vmc` of `cover_specs$combined$all`. All maps are predictions on
all of CONUS (snap mask), not only the available area. Shares are % of the
total (needleleaf and broadleaf: of tree cover, with broadleaf = 100% -
needleleaf as only needleleaf is modelled; C3, C4 and forb: of herbaceous
cover, rescaled to sum to 100%), and are predicted everywhere, including where
there is little or none of the total. Cover of a type is its share times the
total cover. Changes are in percentage points.

```{r components}
spec <- cover_specs$combined$all[[vmc]]
comp <- spec$components
tree_vmc <- comp$vmc[comp$component == "tree_all"]
herb_vmc <- comp$vmc[comp$component == "herbaceous"]

# the models behind each component
bind_rows(
  comp |> filter(component == "shrub"),
  cover_specs$combined$tree_all[[tree_vmc]]$components |>
    mutate(component = paste0("tree_all: ", component)),
  cover_specs$combined$herbaceous[[herb_vmc]]$components |>
    mutate(component = paste0("herbaceous: ", component))
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

# Current climate, all types

Each map has its own colour scale (covers: 0 to the 99th percentile; shares:
0-100%).

```{r map-all-current, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 14}
g_all <- pmap(vars, \(layer, label, is_share, ...) {
  r <- pred$current[[layer]]
  plot_map_conus(r, colorscale = value_scale(list(r), is_share),
                 title = label)
})
names(g_all) <- vars$layer

# rows: tree, needleleaf; shrub, herbaceous; herbaceous covers; shares
layout <- list(g_all$cover_tree, g_all$cover_needle, g_all$share_needle,
               g_all$cover_broad, g_all$share_broad, g_all$cover_shrub,
                g_all$cover_herbaceous, plot_spacer(), plot_spacer(),
               g_all$cover_c3, g_all$cover_c4, g_all$cover_forb,
               g_all$share_c3, g_all$share_c4, g_all$share_forb)
wrap_plots(layout, ncol = 3) & legend_bottom
```

# Current and future, by type {.tabset}

For each layer: current and future predictions (left), and the change from
current (right).

```{r maps-by-group, results = "asis", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 11}
walk(unique(vars$group), \(g) {
  cat("\n\n## ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
  filter(vars, group == g) |>
    pwalk(\(layer, label, is_share, ...) {
      print(plot_scenarios(layer, label, is_share))
      cat("\n\n")
    })
})
```

# Residuals

## Data

Predicted (current climate) minus observed, in sample: the models were fit
to these data, so this shows the spatial pattern of the errors, not an
independent test (and for random forests the training points are in-bag).
See each model's own diagnostics report for out-of-fold predictions.

- **Tree cover** fit to RAP data (c02): compared wall to wall with the 2021
  RAP tree cover raster the training data were sampled from, with zero-tree
  cells (RAP zero-tree layer, at the zero-tree model's threshold) set to 0,
  as in `01_tree_combined_diagnostics.Rmd`.
- **Everything else**: the predictions extracted at the training pixels of
  the data version of the model(s) the layer comes from (e.g. c01 for
  shrub, herbaceous and the shares), mapped as the mean over years at each
  pixel. Observed shares are the field fractions (`frac_<type>`, as %);
  observed cover of a type is its parent cover times its fraction, as the
  predictions are built, e.g. modelled `share_c3` is compared with
  `100 * frac_c3`, and `cover_c3` with `cov_herbaceous * frac_c3` (needleleaf:
  `cov_tree * frac_needle`). Broadleaf isn't modelled directly (its share is
  100% minus the needleleaf share), so its observations are those of the
  needleleaf model, with `frac_broad` (= 1 - `frac_needle`). The
  component covers (`c_<type>`) are not used: LFRDB's are summed species
  cover, which can exceed 100%, and LDC's are any-hit rather than first-hit.

Quantile plots use the training pixel-years and the f5 predictors
(`.pred_vars$f5`), whatever the models were fit with.

```{r resid-data}
# data version of the observations for each layer: that of the model(s) the
# layer comes from
tree_all_comp <- cover_specs$combined$tree_all[[tree_vmc]]$components
tree_parts <- cover_specs$combined$tree[[
  tree_all_comp$vmc[tree_all_comp$component == "tree"]]]$components
herb_comp <- cover_specs$combined$herbaceous[[herb_vmc]]$components

vc_of <- function(x, comp) unname(comp$vc[comp$component == x])
vc_tree <- unique(tree_parts$vc[tree_parts$cover_type == "cover"])
stopifnot(length(vc_tree) == 1)

# by type (the layer name without cover_ / share_)
vc_lookup <- c(tree       = vc_tree,
               needle     = vc_of("needle", tree_all_comp),
               # broad isn't modelled directly (share = 1 - needle share)
               broad      = vc_of("needle", tree_all_comp),
               shrub      = vc_of("shrub", comp),
               herbaceous = vc_of("herbaceous", herb_comp),
               c3         = vc_of("c3", herb_comp),
               c4         = vc_of("c4", herb_comp),
               forb       = vc_of("forb", herb_comp))
vars <- vars |>
  mutate(type = str_remove(layer, "^(cover|share)_"),
         vc = unname(vc_lookup[type]))
stopifnot(!anyNA(vars$vc))

# zero-tree threshold of the combined tree cover's zero-tree model
zt <- filter(tree_parts, component == "zero_tree")
zt_threshold <- read_cover_model(zt$cover_type, zt$cover_model, zt$vc,
                                 zt$vmc)$config$spec$cover_threshold

#' Observed value of a layer in the training data (%)
#'
#' Tree cover is set to 0 where the zero-tree % is above the zero-tree
#' threshold (where that column exists), as the predictions are. Shares are
#' the fractions (`frac_<type>`) as %; cover of a type is its parent cover
#' times its fraction (needle, broad: `cov_tree`; c3, c4, forb:
#' `cov_herbaceous`), and 0 where the parent cover is 0.
#'
#' @param d Training data (`read_cover_training()`).
#' @param layer Layer name, e.g. "cover_forb".
#' @return Numeric vector, NA where not observed.
observed_layer <- function(d, layer) {
  type <- str_remove(layer, "^(cover|share)_")
  if (layer == "cover_tree") {
    zero <- if ("pct_zero_tree" %in% names(d)) {
      !is.na(d$pct_zero_tree) & d$pct_zero_tree > zt_threshold
    } else {
      rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
    }
    return(if_else(zero, 0, d$cov_tree))
  }
  if (type %in% c("shrub", "herbaceous")) return(d[[paste0("cov_", type)]])
  frac <- d[[paste0("frac_", type)]]
  if (str_starts(layer, "share_")) return(100 * frac)
  parent <- if (type %in% c("needle", 'broad')) d$cov_tree else d$cov_herbaceous
  # fractions are undefined where the parent class is absent
  if_else(!is.na(parent) & parent == 0, 0, parent * frac)
}

# training data with the current predictions at each pixel (pred_<layer>)
train <- map(unique(vars$vc), \(v) {
  d <- read_cover_training(v)
  p <- terra::extract(pred$current, as.matrix(d[c("x", "y")]))
  bind_cols(d, rename_with(as_tibble(p), \(n) paste0("pred_", n)))
}) |>
  set_names(unique(vars$vc))

f5 <- .pred_vars$f5

# wall-to-wall observed tree cover (c02 only)
wall <- vc_tree == "c02"
if (wall) {
  rap_tree <- terra::rast(file.path(paths$large, "Data_processed/CoverData/rap",
                                    "RAP_v3_cover_2021_1000m.tif"))[["tree"]]
  rap_zero <- 100 * read_zero_tree_raster("fracZeroTree") > zt_threshold
  # GEE exports are one cell larger than the snap grid
  rap_tree <- align_raster(rap_tree, pred$current)
  rap_zero <- align_raster(rap_zero, pred$current)
  obs_tree <- terra::ifel(rap_zero == 1, 0, rap_tree) |>
    terra::mask(rap_tree) |>  # NA where either layer is missing
    terra::mask(rap_zero)
  diff_tree <- terra::mask(pred$current$cover_tree, obs_tree) - obs_tree
}
```

```{r resid-fun}
#' Pixel-year table of observed and predicted values of one layer
resid_df <- function(layer, vc) {
  train[[vc]] |>
    mutate(cover = observed_layer(train[[vc]], layer),
           cover_pred = .data[[paste0("pred_", layer)]]) |>
    filter(!is.na(cover), !is.na(cover_pred))
}

#' Map of predicted - observed at the training pixels (mean over years)
plot_resid_points <- function(df, label, unit) {
  px <- df |>
    summarise(resid = mean(cover_pred - cover), .by = c(cell, x, y)) |>
    sf::st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = terra::crs(pred$current))
  lim <- max(abs(quantile(px$resid, c(0.05, 0.95), names = FALSE)))
  plot_points_conus(px, color_var = "resid", point_size = 0.3,
                    colorscale = colorscale_diverging(
                      name = paste0("Predicted -\nobserved\n(", unit, ")"),
                      limits = c(-lim, lim), aesthetics = "colour"),
                    title = paste(label, "- residuals at training pixels"),
                    inset_hist = TRUE)
}

#' Quantile plot of observed and predicted against the f5 predictors
plot_resid_quantiles <- function(df, label, ylab) {
  predvars2deciles(df, response_vars = c("cover", "cover_pred"),
                   pred_vars = f5) |>
    decile_dotplot("cover", df = _, ylab = ylab, add_predicted = TRUE,
                   title = label, add_ribbon = TRUE)
}
```

## Fit metrics

In sample, for every layer: at the training pixel-years (data version
`vc`), and for tree cover also wall to wall against the RAP raster (all
cells with RAP data). Units are % cover, or % share for shares. MSE is
RMSE^2; R^2 is 1 - SSE/SST (negative when the predictions do worse than the
observed mean); bias is mean(predicted - observed).

```{r resid-metrics}
metrics <- pmap(vars, \(layer, label, vc, ...) {
  df <- resid_df(layer, vc)
  cover_metrics(df$cover, df$cover_pred) |>
    mutate(layer = layer, label = label, compared_to = paste("training", vc),
           .before = 1)
}) |>
  bind_rows()

if (wall) {
  v <- terra::values(c(obs_tree, pred$current$cover_tree), mat = TRUE,
                     na.rm = TRUE)
  metrics <- cover_metrics(v[, 1], v[, 2]) |>
    mutate(layer = "cover_tree", label = "Tree cover",
           compared_to = "RAP 2021 raster", .before = 1) |>
    bind_rows(metrics)
  rm(v)
}

metrics |>
  mutate(MSE = RMSE^2, .before = RMSE) |>
  select(-layer) |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```

## By type {.tabset}

```{r resid-by-group, results = "asis", fig.width = 10, fig.height = 7}
walk(unique(vars$group), \(g) {
  cat("\n\n### ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
  filter(vars, group == g) |>
    pwalk(\(layer, label, is_share, vc, ...) {
      unit <- if (is_share) "% share" else "% cover"
      ylab <- paste0(if (is_share) "Share" else "Cover", " (%)")
      df <- resid_df(layer, vc)
      cat("\n\n", label, ": ", nrow(df), " pixel-years (", vc, ")\n\n",
          sep = "")

      if (layer == "cover_tree" && wall) {
        lim <- max(abs(c(raster_quantile(diff_tree, 0.05),
                         raster_quantile(diff_tree, 0.95))))
        print(plot_map_conus(diff_tree,
                             colorscale = colorscale_diverging(
                               name = "Predicted -\nRAP (% cover)",
                               limits = c(-lim, lim)),
                             title = "Tree cover - predicted minus RAP 2021",
                             inset_hist = TRUE))
      } else {
        print(plot_resid_points(df, label, unit))
      }
      cat("\n\n")
      print(plot_resid_quantiles(df, label, ylab))
      cat("\n\n")
    })
})
```
